_comment: Per-bucket in-scope PASS-COUNT floor for the WPT regression gate (scripts/wpt-scoreboard.php). Gate on counts, not percentages: counts are stable while the corpus total drifts; `tolerance` absorbs rasterisation jitter. REGENERATED IN CI 2026-09-25 via the wpt-gate workflow_dispatch with update=true, which is the ONLY correct way to set these numbers: pass counts depend on installed fonts, and the previous revision had been generated on a developer machine, so the gate failed on an environment mismatch (measuring css 11549 against a committed 11693) rather than on any regression. CI and local agree exactly on svg (220) and mathml (119) and differ by 1 on html; css is the font-sensitive bucket, where CI reads 12129 against 12271 locally. Settler-OFF, harness default font. Refresh ONLY by re-running that dispatch and committing its artifact, never from a local run.
